## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_SWEEP_BLOCKER gate is causing a quality-lock cascade that blocks BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries on J's winner days (4/29 and 5/01), turning potential profits into losses. Removing this blocker should allow the engine to capture the expected winner-day P&L while maintaining its ability to skip loser-day trades, thereby increasing edge_capture above the OP-16 floor of 771 and reducing concentration by distributing profits more evenly across anchor days.

## Mechanism

Remove the BEARISH_SWEEP_BLOCKER gate (currently implemented in `backtest/lib/risk_gate.py` as the `sweep_blocker` function). This gate blocks entries when a bearish sweep pattern is detected. Current engine behavior shows losses on 4/29 (-$23.95) and 5/01 (-$21.56) where profits were expected (+$342 and +$470). By removing this blocker, we allow the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup to trigger on these days, potentially capturing the full ribbon-ride profits. The gate's removal will be compensated by existing quality-escalation logic and chart-stop exits to manage risk.
